MenuNori / Travel guides

A SMALL REHEARSAL FOR KOREA

A little practice before Korea.

MenuNori helps travelers rehearse the moment between looking at a Korean menu and placing an order. It is a small, independent project created by Jeremy (제레미).

What you can practice

Our fictional bunsik shop has six dishes and five missions. Read the menu, choose dine-in or takeaway, adjust quantities and options, and check your basket. When you finish, the result explains what matched the mission and what needs another look.

What makes the menu fictional?

The restaurant name, prices, recipes, and ordering screen were created for this experience. They are not copied from a real restaurant. Food artwork is AI-generated and illustrative. Korean dish names and useful phrases are learning examples, not promises about any particular restaurant’s ingredients, prices, or service.

How the content is made

Menu and mission text are fixed content rather than live AI responses. The English explanations and Korean examples are prepared for this version. Independent native-speaker review has not yet been completed. We do not offer pronunciation scoring, ingredient verification, or real restaurant search.

Free to use

You do not need an account. No real order or payment is made. The practice interface stores only your language preference and completed mission numbers in this browser. There are no ads or analytics scripts in this version. If advertising is introduced later, the privacy information will be updated before it runs.

Contact

Operator: Jeremy (제레미). A public contact email has not yet been added. Direct contact and a correction channel will be provided before a public advertising launch.

Preparing a trip? Use MenuNori alongside current restaurant information, translation tools, and help from staff. The game is a rehearsal of decisions, not a substitute for the actual menu.
